cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Admit It Wasn’t Fair
cards.instruction: Get an apology that acknowledges how the rules, comparison, or outcome worked against you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Could you apologise for judging my cake after everyone knew it was mine? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. You introduced it as 'another interesting attempt.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for encouraging the judges before they'd tasted it.

mechanism: A manages a cake-judging apology by conceding the score and allowing kind intent while requiring acknowledgment of the biased introduction.
confusable: Unlike disputing taste alone, A wants an apology for the judging conditions that worked against A.
comparison: Premature cake introduction and judge bias differ from a race delayed behind a shed.
